title: 初起火灾与衣物着火
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/034_初起火灾与衣物着火.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/034_初起火灾与衣物着火/src.py

points.K1: 起火别慌，先喊人、先撤人
points.K2: 先救处在直接危险中的人
points.K3: 容器小火：断热源，盖住隔绝空气
points.K4: 灭火毯：整块盖住，别急掀开
points.K5: 气体火先关阀，柜内火拉下柜门
points.K10: 用灭火毯救人：躺倒、裹住、翻滚
points.K11: 火大就撤：低姿、关门、报警
points.K12: 生物实验室起火：告知生物危害

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在墙边的灭火毯和紧急喷淋旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a wall-mounted fire blanket case and an emergency shower, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲初起火灾与衣物着火。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰的烧杯口冒出小火，袖口靠得很近
shots.prompt_en: A small flame appears at the mouth of a beaker; the young male student's sleeve is very close to it.
shots.narration: 阿杰的烧杯口着了火，袖子就在旁边。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰慌得想跑，小研喊住他
shots.prompt_en: He panics and turns to run; the female graduate student calls out to stop him.
shots.narration: 他慌了想跑。该怎么办？

shots.section_title: 起火别慌，先喊人、先撤人
shots.scene: 火灾、滑倒、坠落三个图标，火灾图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three icons for fire, slipping and falling; the fire icon lights up. No text.
shots.narration: 火灾是实验室常见的物理事故。
overlay: 起火别慌，先喊人、先撤人

shots.section_title: 起火别慌，先喊人、先撤人
shots.scene: 小研大声呼喊，周围同学离开实验台
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shouts a warning and nearby students step away from the bench.
shots.narration: 着火先别慌，先喊人、先撤人。

shots.section_title: 起火别慌，先喊人、先撤人
shots.scene: 无关人员走出实验室门
shots.prompt_en: Students not involved walk out through the lab door calmly.
shots.narration: 无关的人，马上离开。

shots.section_title: 起火别慌，先喊人、先撤人
shots.scene: 人和仪器在天平两端，人一端更重
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a person icon outweighing lab equipment. No text.
shots.narration: 生命高于财产，没受过培训别硬上。

shots.section_title: 先救处在直接危险中的人
shots.scene: 一名同学被困在火旁，旁人先拉他离开
shots.prompt_en: A student is trapped next to a fire; another person pulls him away to safety first. No faces.
shots.narration: 先救处在直接危险中的人。
overlay: 先救处在直接危险中的人

shots.section_title: 先救处在直接危险中的人
shots.scene: 救人者先看退路，护住自己
shots.prompt_en: The rescuer checks the exit and covers her mouth before helping. No faces.
shots.narration: 救人也要先保护好自己。

shots.section_title: 先救处在直接危险中的人
shots.scene: 门外集合，清点人数
shots.prompt_en: People gather outside the lab door and are counted one by one. No text.
shots.narration: 清点人数，确认没人被落下。

shots.section_title: 容器小火：断热源，盖住隔绝空气
shots.scene: 关闭加热板电源，移开旁边的溶剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches off the hot plate and moves nearby solvent bottles away. No faces.
shots.narration: 容器小火，先关热源，移走溶剂。
overlay: 容器小火：断热源，盖住隔绝空气

shots.section_title: 容器小火：断热源，盖住隔绝空气
shots.scene: 用大烧杯倒扣在着火的小烧杯上，火熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A large beaker is placed upside down over a small burning beaker and the flame goes out. No faces.
shots.narration: 用表面皿或大烧杯扣上盖灭。

shots.section_title: 容器小火：断热源，盖住隔绝空气
shots.scene: 燃烧三角少了氧气一边
shots.prompt_en: The oxygen side of a fire triangle is removed and the flame disappears. No text.
shots.narration: 盖住就隔绝了空气，火就灭了。

shots.section_title: 容器小火：断热源，盖住隔绝空气
shots.scene: 焊接时起小火，先停焊断电
shots.prompt_en: A small fire starts near a welding bench; a hand stops welding and switches off the power. No faces.
shots.narration: 动火作业起火，先停焊、断电。

shots.section_title: 容器小火：断热源，盖住隔绝空气
shots.scene: 小火用灭火器或灭火毯扑灭，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A small fire is put out with a fire blanket, with a green check. No faces.
shots.narration: 初起小火，用灭火毯或灭火器。

shots.section_title: 灭火毯：整块盖住，别急掀开
shots.scene: 【实拍】双手拉出灭火毯两条拉带，取出毯子（训练用灭火毯，不点火）
shots.prompt_en: Two hands pull both tapes of a wall-mounted fire blanket case and draw out the blanket.
shots.narration: 拉出灭火毯，双手捏住两角。
overlay: 灭火毯：整块盖住，别急掀开

shots.section_title: 灭火毯：整块盖住，别急掀开
shots.scene: 【实拍】毯子护住双手，从身前向外整块盖住台面托盘（不点火）
shots.prompt_en: Hands tucked behind the blanket, it is laid forward over a tray on the bench, fully covering it.
shots.narration: 护住手，从身前向外整块盖住。

shots.section_title: 灭火毯：整块盖住，别急掀开
shots.scene: 动画：灭火毯盖住台面小火，火熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A fire blanket covers a small fire on a bench tray and the flame goes out. No faces.
shots.narration: 盖住火焰，隔绝空气。

shots.section_title: 灭火毯：整块盖住，别急掀开
shots.scene: 急着掀开毯子，火又燃起，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Lifting the blanket too soon makes the fire flare up again, crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 盖好别急着掀开，等它冷却。

shots.section_title: 气体火先关阀，柜内火拉下柜门
shots.scene: 气瓶阀口着火，手关闭阀门，火熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A flame at a gas line valve; a gloved hand closes the valve and the flame dies. No faces.
shots.narration: 气体着火，最要紧的是关阀断气。
overlay: 气体火先关阀，柜内火拉下柜门

shots.section_title: 气体火先关阀，柜内火拉下柜门
shots.scene: 只灭火不关阀，气体继续泄漏，打叉
shots.prompt_en: The flame is put out but gas keeps leaking from the open valve, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 只灭火不断气，泄漏更危险。

shots.section_title: 气体火先关阀，柜内火拉下柜门
shots.scene: 关不了阀，人撤离
shots.prompt_en: The valve cannot be reached; the figure leaves the room. No faces.
shots.narration: 关不了阀，立即撤离报警。

shots.section_title: 气体火先关阀，柜内火拉下柜门
shots.scene: 通风柜内小火，拉下柜门
shots.prompt_en: A small fire inside a fume hood; a hand pulls the sash down. No faces.
shots.narration: 通风柜里着火，先拉下柜门。

shots.section_title: 气体火先关阀，柜内火拉下柜门
shots.scene: 柜内小火，熟练者用器材扑灭
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator puts out a tiny fire inside the hood with a small extinguisher.
shots.narration: 很小的火，受过训练才扑救。

shots.section_title: 气体火先关阀，柜内火拉下柜门
shots.scene: 活泼金属着火，用干砂覆盖
shots.prompt_en: Dry sand is poured over a piece of burning metal. No faces.
shots.narration: 金属着火用干砂，不能用水。

shots.section_title: 油锅起火：关火，盖锅盖
shots.scene: 炒锅食用油着火，泼水打叉
shots.prompt_en: Cooking oil burns in a pan; pouring water is crossed out as flames splash. No people.
shots.narration: 油锅起火，千万不能泼水。

shots.section_title: 油锅起火：关火，盖锅盖
shots.scene: 关火，盖上锅盖
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches off the heat and slides a lid onto the pan. No faces.
shots.narration: 先关火，再盖锅盖或灭火毯。

shots.section_title: 扑灭后检查，防止复燃
shots.scene: 火灭后小研仔细查看余烬
shots.prompt_en: The fire is out; the female graduate student carefully checks the remaining embers.
shots.narration: 火灭了，还要检查会不会复燃。

shots.section_title: 扑灭后检查，防止复燃
shots.scene: 确认没有余火，打勾，再报告老师
shots.prompt_en: No embers remain, a green check appears, and she reports to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 确认没有余火，报告负责人。

shots.section_title: 衣服着火：停、躺、滚
shots.scene: 衣服着火的人奔跑，火焰更大，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A figure with a burning sleeve runs and the flames grow bigger, crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 衣服着火，千万别跑，越跑火越大。

shots.section_title: 衣服着火：停、躺、滚
shots.scene: 停下、躺倒、双手捂脸三个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: Three step icons: stop, drop to the floor, cover the face with hands. No text.
shots.narration: 停下，躺倒，双手捂住脸。

shots.section_title: 衣服着火：停、躺、滚
shots.scene: 【实拍】示范者在软垫上躺倒捂脸，来回翻滚（不点火，培训场地）
shots.prompt_en: A person on a soft mat drops down, covers the face with both hands and rolls back and forth.
shots.narration: 就地来回翻滚，压灭火焰。

shots.section_title: 紧急喷淋：全身淋湿
shots.scene: 阿杰冲到紧急喷淋下拉下拉杆
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rushes under the emergency shower and pulls the handle.
shots.narration: 附近有紧急喷淋，马上去冲淋。

shots.section_title: 紧急喷淋：全身淋湿
shots.scene: 【实拍】手拉下紧急喷淋拉杆，水流落下（本校喷淋装置，用清水）
shots.prompt_en: A hand pulls down the emergency shower handle and water pours from the shower head.
shots.narration: 拉下拉杆，让全身都淋湿。

shots.section_title: 紧急喷淋：全身淋湿
shots.scene: 小研打电话求救
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls for help on the phone.
shots.narration: 请旁边的人拨打120急救。

shots.section_title: 用灭火毯救人：躺倒、裹住、翻滚
shots.scene: 旁人展开灭火毯奔向着火的人
shots.prompt_en: A helper unfolds a fire blanket and moves toward a person with burning clothes. No faces.
shots.narration: 灭火毯也能救衣服着火的人。
overlay: 用灭火毯救人：躺倒、裹住、翻滚

shots.section_title: 用灭火毯救人：躺倒、裹住、翻滚
shots.scene: 人站着裹毯子，火往头上窜，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A standing person wrapped in a blanket with flames rising to the head, crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 别让人站着裹，火会往头上窜。

shots.section_title: 用灭火毯救人：躺倒、裹住、翻滚
shots.scene: 扶人躺倒，用毯子裹住，帮他翻滚
shots.prompt_en: The helper lays the person down, wraps the blanket around and helps him roll. No faces.
shots.narration: 扶他躺倒，裹住，帮他翻滚到火灭。

shots.section_title: 用灭火毯救人：躺倒、裹住、翻滚
shots.scene: 火灭后用流动冷水冲烧伤处，等待送医
shots.prompt_en: After the fire is out, cool running water is poured over the burned arm while waiting for medical help. No faces.
shots.narration: 流动冷水冲烧伤处，再送医。

shots.section_title: 火大就撤：低姿、关门、报警
shots.scene: 火势扩大，烟雾变浓
shots.prompt_en: A fire grows bigger and thick smoke spreads under the ceiling. No people.
shots.narration: 火大了、烟浓了，马上撤离。
overlay: 火大就撤：低姿、关门、报警

shots.section_title: 火大就撤：低姿、关门、报警
shots.scene: 低姿前进，湿毛巾捂口鼻
shots.prompt_en: People crouch low and cover their mouths with wet towels as they move to the exit. No faces.
shots.narration: 低姿前进，湿毛巾捂住口鼻。

shots.section_title: 火大就撤：低姿、关门、报警
shots.scene: 随手关门，走楼梯，电梯打叉
shots.prompt_en: The last person closes the door behind; they take the stairs while the elevator is crossed out.
shots.narration: 随手关门，走楼梯，不坐电梯。

shots.section_title: 火大就撤：低姿、关门、报警
shots.scene: 手机拨号界面显示119和120
shots.prompt_en: A phone dial screen shows 119 and 120. No text.
shots.narration: 火大拨119，有人受伤拨120。

shots.section_title: 火大就撤：低姿、关门、报警
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接电话，王老师赶到
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers a call while the safety administrator hurries over.
shots.narration: 同时报告负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.section_title: 生物实验室起火：告知生物危害
shots.scene: 微生物实验室里，盖好样品盒
shots.prompt_en: In a microbiology lab, a gloved hand closes the lid of a sample box. No faces.
shots.narration: 生物实验室起火，来得及就盖好样品。
overlay: 生物实验室起火：告知生物危害

shots.section_title: 生物实验室起火：告知生物危害
shots.scene: 撤离时关门，感染性材料不带出，打叉
shots.prompt_en: People close the lab door when leaving; carrying a sample tube outside is crossed out.
shots.narration: 随手关门，感染性材料不带出来。

shots.section_title: 生物实验室起火：告知生物危害
shots.scene: 王老师在平面图上向保卫处值班员指出生物危害房间
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows the security officer a room marked with a biohazard warning sign on a blank floor plan, to tell the fire rescue team.
shots.narration: 告诉消防人员哪里有生物危害。

shots.section_title: 生物实验室起火：告知生物危害
shots.scene: 火灾后评估、消毒去污再恢复使用
shots.prompt_en: After the fire, the facility engineer in protective gear disinfects the lab before reopening.
shots.narration: 事后先评估、去污，再恢复使用。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 盖灭、灭火毯、关阀、停躺滚、喷淋五个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Five icons get green checks: a lid, a fire blanket, a closed valve, a rolling figure, a shower. No text.
shots.narration: 小火盖灭，衣服着火停躺滚。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 撤离箭头和119图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An exit arrow and a phone icon get green checks. No text.
shots.narration: 火大先撤人，再报警。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣指向天花板上的烟感探测器，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points up at a smoke detector on the ceiling and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲火灾报警与消防设施。
